name: Kellogg's Eggo Homestyle Frozen Waffles (Toasted)
whyItWorks: Made from refined enriched wheat flour with a light, airy grid texture that crisps on the outside and stays fluffy inside. With just 1g fiber and low fat, it is a comforting, low-residue morning carb.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Toast until lightly golden (not dark or charred). Top with a dab of butter and 100% pure maple syrup.
watchOuts: Contains wheat and egg ingredients; chew well.
